description: This file defines a utility object `ImageCacheUtils` providing functions to clear image caches and cancel ongoing image requests, primarily used for testing or debugging in an Android TV application.

classes.name: ImageCacheUtils
classes.description: A singleton object providing utility functions to clear image caches and cancel image requests for `ImageView` instances in testing/debugging scenarios.

methods.name: clearAllCoilCaches
methods.description: Suspends execution to clear Coil's memory and disk caches using the provided Android context.

methods.name: cancelOngoingRequest
methods.description: Cancels any ongoing image request associated with the provided `ImageView` by calling its `dispose()` extension method.
